## Scope

The quality audit reviewed 558 second reads completed during the audit period. The review focused on the consistency of grading decisions and the level of agreement between the assessments recorded. It was undertaken to provide a clear summary of current grading performance and to identify any issues requiring follow-up. The audit findings are intended to support routine quality assurance and ongoing discussion of grading practice.

## Result

Overall agreement was 59.7 per cent. This result provides the general performance measure for the audit and should be considered alongside the findings for individual graders. Per-grader results are available in the attached spreadsheet. These results will be discussed privately with each grader to support understanding of the findings and, where appropriate, identify areas for review. The audit outcome should be used as part of normal quality improvement activity, with any further action agreed through the usual review process.
